Dominikanska Republika
Consular help:Consular help will be provided by the Embassy of Bosnia and Herzegovina in Washington or by the Consulate General in Chicago, USA.
Visa required for the following traveling documentation for BH citizens:
Regular biometric passport - NO, for tourist purposes.
Service/Official biometric passport - YES, the visa is issued in Vienna.
Diplomatic biometric passport - YES, the visa is issued in Vienna.
Citizens of Bosnia and Herzegovina may enter the Dominican Republic without a visa, provided that they purchase a tourist card upon arrival at the airport. More detailed information can be found on the website of the General Directorate of Migration: https://migracion.gob.do/en/
Citizens of the Dominican Republic are required visas when entering, exiting or travelling through Bosnia and Herzegovina. Visa shall be issued in Washington or Chicago, USA.
Security Conditions: We have no information indicating that travel to the country should be postponed.
